cohort: The study included 225 eligible pregnant women attending a tertiary care hospital in Hyderabad, Telangana, India.
finding: The study found a GDM prevalence of 18.7% and identified significant associations with age over 26 years, higher BMI, multigravidity, consanguinity, history of abortion, PCOS/infertility, family history of diabetes, higher educational level, excess calorie intake, sedentary lifestyle, past GDM, and history of macrosomic babies.
cross-section timing: Data analysis and report writing were performed from January 2016 to May 2016.
